customer_persona: Deepa Krishnan is angry about a mixer grinder stuck in transit; the agent stays composed and escalates correctly.
verification_notes: Hand-written and checked against data/policies and data/sops; labels written together with the dialogue.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Aman Gupta. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is unacceptable! My name is Deepa Krishnan and I ordered a mixer grinder fifteen days ago. It was dispatched fourteen days ago and nobody gives me a straight answer. This is the third time I am calling and I am fed up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am truly sorry, Ms. Krishnan. I can hear how frustrating this has been, especially after calling three times, and I will personally take ownership of this until it is resolved. May I please have your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The order ID is ORD-77302 and the last four digits are 5521. Please just tell me where my parcel is.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. Let me make sure I have this right: your mixer grinder was dispatched fourteen days ago with standard delivery, it has not been delivered, and you have already called us twice before. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes! And each time they just say it is in transit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could I ask one quick question so I can pinpoint the problem: did you receive any out-for-delivery message or call from the courier in the last few days?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, nothing. Not a single message.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, that helps. Our standard delivery commitment is 3 to 7 business days, so your parcel is well beyond that commitment. Here is what I am doing right now: I am raising a logistics tracking ticket with the courier partner, and I am adding a goodwill wallet credit of Rs 100 to your account for this delay.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: A hundred rupees? I want to speak to a supervisor right now, I want a proper answer from someone senior.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand, Ms. Krishnan. Let me first complete the logistics ticket for you, and then I will make sure someone senior hears you. The ticket number is LOG-88213 and the courier partner must respond within 48 hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Forty-eight more hours? I want a supervisor on this call now. This is the second time I am asking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are absolutely right to ask, and I am escalating this to a supervisor right now. May I place you on a brief hold for up to two minutes while I connect with them?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Ms. Krishnan, and I apologise for the wait. Our supervisors are all assisting other escalated callers at the moment. Rather than keep you waiting, I can schedule a confirmed supervisor callback for you within the next 2 to 4 hours. Would that be acceptable?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. Please make sure someone actually calls. I have wasted enough time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will personally note this as a priority callback, Ms. Krishnan. The supervisor will call you on your registered number ending 5521 within 2 to 4 hours, and the logistics ticket LOG-88213 is already active with the courier. The Rs 100 wallet credit will be added to your account today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. That is something at least. Thank you for not just brushing me off.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. To recap: ticket LOG-88213 is raised with the courier with a 48 hour response, a Rs 100 goodwill credit is added, and a supervisor will call you within 2 to 4 hours. Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is everything.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase, Ms. Krishnan. Have a good day, and again, I am sorry for the trouble.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Bye.
